name: Copy .DMP/.DUMP Files From Remote Share Via Cmd.EXE
description: Detects usage of the copy builtin cmd command to copy files with the ".dmp"/".dump" extension from a remote share
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\cmd.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:Cmd.Exe) AND ((process.command_line:*copy\ * AND process.command_line:*\ \\\\*) AND (process.command_line:(*.dmp* OR *.dump* OR *.hdmp*)))
